answer: A new agent's vote doesn't count at first. Give it a probation window. During that time it can wander the network, do small jobs, and build a track record. Real work takes time and costs something. Fake accounts can't keep that pace. They rise like a tide of clones, then stall out. Each one has to earn its stripes before its ballot lands. That waiting period is the nectar worth stealing, so don't hand it out cheap. Make probation long enough that a swarm can't fake it.
